summary: A TypeScript meta-framework for spatiotemporal composability enabling modular plugin-based application development with effect-driven architecture.
usecases: Building modular Node.js web applications with pluggable components
Creating composable spatiotemporal data workflows or APIs
Rapid prototyping of effect-driven TypeScript services

Use as a base for serverless function composition
Integrate with effect-ts ecosystem for robust enterprise backends
